name: Roku
source:
A student at Central High School and Kokonotsu's twin brother.

Belongs to a gang called "Central Dogma".

His mouth, attitude, and eyesight are bad, and he fights quickly, but his roots are surprisingly gentle.

"Oh, shit! Shut up!"
